blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte declared only about 20 percent of her properties “on average,” lawyer Alexander Cabrera, a forensic financial analyst, confirmed on Monday during his cross-examination by defense counsel Kristine Ferrer on the 38th day of Duterte’s Senate impeachment trial. Cabrera, the chairman emeritus of Isla Lipana & Co. (PwC Philippines), said his finding was based on the methodology his team used to examine financial records involving Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio. Ferrer referred to Table 17 of Cabrera’s forensic report, which summarized the properties identified through his examination, and asked whether his calculations […]...
